title: Raking for estimation and inference in panel models with nonignorable attrition and refreshment
abstract: arXiv:2512.13270v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In panel data subject to nonignorable attrition, auxiliary (refreshment) sampling may restore full identification under weak assumptions on the attrition process. Despite their generality, these identification strategies have seen limited empirical use, largely because the implied estimation procedure requires solving a functional minimization problem for the target density. When the distributions of the observed data are parametric, we show that this problem can be solved using the iterative proportional fitting (raking) algorithm, which converges rapidly even with continuous data. The resulting density estimator is then used as input into a parametric moment condition. We establish consistency and convergence rates for both the raking-based density estimator and the resulting moment estimator. translated_title: 用于具有不可忽略流失与补充抽样的面板模型估计与推断的倾斜法（Raking）
translated_abstract: 在存在不可忽略流失的面板数据中，辅助（补充）抽样可以在对流失过程的较弱假设下恢复完全识别。尽管这些识别策略具有普遍性，但其实证应用却十分有限，主要原因是隐含的估计过程需要求解目标密度的泛函极小化问题。我们证明，当观测数据的分布为参数形式时，该问题可以通过迭代比例拟合（raking）算法求解，即使面对连续数据，该算法也能快速收敛。所得的密度估计量随后被用作参数化矩条件的输入。我们为基于raking的密度估计量以及由此得到的矩估计量建立了一致性和收敛速度，还推导了一个估计渐近方差的简单递归程序。最后，我们展示了……的满意表现（原文摘要到此截断）。
tldr: 本文证明当观测数据分布为参数形式时，不可忽略流失面板模型识别所需的泛函极小化问题可通过快速收敛的迭代比例拟合（raking）算法求解，并据此建立了一致性、收敛速度及渐近方差的递归估计方法，使补充抽样识别策略在实证中切实可用。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the functional minimization problem underlying identification of panel models with nonignorable attrition and refreshment sampling can be solved via the rapidly converging iterative proportional fitting (raking) algorithm, and establishes consistency, convergence rates, and a recursive asymptotic variance estimator, making these identification strategies practically applicable in empirical work.
